seedCustody: The public committed seed freezes all future ordering. It is not a secrecy claim. Independent AI blind reviewers receive packet objects only and have no repository, seed, generation script, mapping or result-file access before ratings lock.
messageEncoding: UTF-8 of the exact ASCII strings below; HMAC key is the 32 bytes decoded from seedHex; lowercase hexadecimal digest; no locale collation
itemIds: first 24 hex characters of HMAC('item-id-v1|' + reviewerId + '|' + caseId + '|' + armId)
itemOrder: ascending full lowercase HMAC('item-order-v1|' + reviewerId + '|' + caseId + '|' + armId), with opaque item ID ascending as a tie-breaker; each reviewer receives all 192 packets once
rawIds: first 24 hex characters of HMAC('raw-id-v1|' + rawReviewerId + '|' + caseId), where rawReviewerId is R1, R2, or R3; raw reviewers do not see caseId
rawOrder: ascending full lowercase HMAC('raw-order-v1|' + rawReviewerId + '|' + caseId), with opaque RAW ID ascending as a tie-breaker
pairIds: first 24 hex characters of HMAC('pair-id-v1|' + reviewerId + '|' + caseId + '|' + pairCode)
pairOrder: ascending full lowercase HMAC('pair-order-v1|' + reviewerId + '|' + caseId + '|' + pairCode), with opaque pair ID ascending as a tie-breaker; each reviewer receives all 240 pairs once
orientation: Let d be HMAC('pair-left-v1|' + reviewerId + '|' + caseId + '|' + pairCode). If first digest byte AND 1 is 0, textA is first arm in pairCode and textB second; otherwise reverse. Reviewer domains are independent. Do not force balance or reroll.
packetSerialization: UTF-8 JSON objects with only exact listed fields, in listed key order; do not include filenames or path metadata in reviewer delivery; same source/objective bytes per case across all arms; output text unaltered
mappingCustody: Keep the reviewer-specific opaque-ID→case/arm/left-right mapping in a separate restricted custodian record, exclusive-write and hash before delivery; no mapping to reviewers until all relevant primary and secondary original ratings lock.
identityLeakLimit: An unchanged SOURCE text necessarily matches the visible SOURCE. Equal final texts can also be recognized as duplicates. Disclose this, collect guesses after primary scoring, and report partial unblinding.
collisionPolicy: Any opaque-ID collision or duplicate order key invalidates packet construction before delivery; no alternate seed or reroll after outputs. Record failure and block judging until an independently audited, prospectively frozen correction is authorized; do not silently regenerate.
